items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: I always stuck to good old Yarlene's jazz.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember the style of any of the musicians that played at the time? Oh yeah. Would you say a little something about that?

Well, I still keep to my same style. Swing and re-bop and everything came out, but I always stuck to good old Yarlene's jazz. Because when you're playing Yarlene's jazz, you don't have to be worried about anything. Just whatever comes in your head you can make.
Well, who were some of the older players around at the time? Were any that had been playing since the real early days still playing?
